_note: Lines for the farmhouse examine events: the paper calendar on the north wall (one part per season: the season, its festival, the villagers' birthdays from data/villagers) and the radio on the chest of drawers.

lines.text: The calendar shows spring. A note in the corner: 'Sow turnips early. Cabbage takes its time.'
The 8th is circled in pink: 'Blossom Day, under the cherry trees in the village.'

A wavy line is drawn on the 12th: 'Mio's birthday.' A little envelope is drawn on the 15th: 'Ren's birthday.' Someone has penciled a name on the 19th, with a little fish: 'Kota's birthday.' A cherry petal is drawn on the 26th: 'Fumi's birthday.'
The calendar shows summer. Morning glories are printed along the edge. 'Water twice when it's hot.'
The 20th is circled in red: 'Lantern Night in the village. Fireworks!'
The 6th, in neat writing: 'Sayo's birthday.' A green rice sprout is drawn on the 13th: 'Genzo's birthday.' A tiny straw sandal is drawn on the 27th: 'Haru's birthday.'
The calendar shows fall, with a picture of rice drying on poles. 'Harvest before the first frost.'
The 15th has a little moon drawn on it: 'Moon Night at the shrine.'

A red maple leaf is drawn on the 4th: 'Kaede's birthday.' A little pile of charcoal is drawn on the 9th: 'Ichiro's birthday.' A tiny red scarf is drawn on the 19th: 'Nana's birthday.' A persimmon is drawn on the 24th: 'Tome's birthday.'
The calendar shows winter. Nothing grows outside now. 'Mend the tools. Rest.'
The 30th is circled twice: 'Year's Turn. A fire at the shrine, all evening.'

A little square of blue cloth is pinned to the 4th: 'Shino's birthday.' The 11th, in thick pencil: 'Hachiro's birthday.' A little hoe is drawn on the 18th: 'Shige's birthday.' A string of dried persimmons is drawn on the 25th: 'Kiku's birthday.'

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: An old valve radio. I turn the knob... static, then a faint song about planting rice, then static again.
